data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for rendering interactive 3D models in glTF and GLB formats.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a Flutter widget that embeds Google's <model-viewer> web component using a WebView on mobile and native web integration on the web platform. It allows rendering interactive 3D models with options for auto-rotation, zooming, and augmented reality (AR) views.
use_when: You need to display interactive 3D models in glTF or GLB format within your Flutter app.
You require cross-platform 3D model rendering supporting Android, iOS, and Web.
avoid_when: Target devices have outdated system browser versions that do not support the required model-viewer features.
You are loading models from remote URLs that do not permit CORS headers.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
Enables AR viewing capabilities on supported devices.
Handles animation, auto-rotation, and custom background colors.
weaknesses: Requires specific platform configuration steps (AndroidManifest.xml, Info.plist, web/index.html).
AR View may not be available on iOS 16+.
Remote models require proper CORS headers to load successfully.
data.setup_notes: Requires modifying AndroidManifest.xml for cleartext traffic on Android 9+, setting minSdkVersion to 24, adding io.flutter.embedded_views_preview to Info.plist on iOS, and including the model-viewer script in web/index.html for Web support.
